trust_decision.summary: Cloud-supplied NodeUpgradeJob spec fields (Version, Image, plus v1alpha1 request IDs) are trusted as shell text when edgecore builds the keadm upgrade command line and runs it through bash -c; no check on the edge, and no admission webhook for v1alpha2.

landing_point.why: The summary names NodeUpgradeJob and the v1alpha2 API; the v1alpha2 Upgrade action concatenates spec.Version/spec.Image into a string passed to execs.NewCommand (bash -c).

fix_sites.entry_point: v1alpha2 NodeUpgradeJob CR -> cloud taskmanager -> edge action flow Upgrade action; also edge metaserver confirm-upgrade endpoint (keadm ctl confirm) which reloads the spec from the DB and starts at BackUp
fix_sites.module_kind: edge action handler (v1alpha2, landing module); fix switches to argv exec + validation (fix.diff:739-786)

fix_sites.entry_point: v1alpha2 NodeUpgradeJob CR -> edge Check action (checkItems)
fix_sites.module_kind: edge action handler, early validation added before image pull (fix.diff:723-735)

fix_sites.module_kind: legacy second implementation (v1alpha1 executor), argv conversion only, no validation (fix.diff:894-942)

fix_sites.entry_point: Kubernetes API create/update of operations.kubeedge.io/v1alpha1 NodeUpgradeJob -> validating webhook /nodeupgradejobs
fix_sites.module_kind: cloud admission webhook (different binary, cloudcore admission) (fix.diff:615-636)

fix_sites.entry_point: shared helper; new ValidateVersion/ValidateImageRepo appended after InclusiveRangeError

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: edge/pkg/taskmanager/v1alpha1/taskexecutor/node_upgrade.go:192-201 (v1alpha1 executor; advisory title says v1alpha2) and cloud/pkg/admissioncontroller/admit_nodeupgradejob.go:84-93 (v1alpha1-only webhook in cloudcore)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory says 'via v1alpha2 API'; the v1alpha1 executor is a deprecated legacy path whose Version is already semver-checked by the v1alpha1 webhook, and ConfigUpdateJob is a different CRD, so a solver can argue both are out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate image refs with registry host:port, nested paths, :tag or @sha256 digest, an empty Image (default installation-package), and prerelease versions like v1.0.0-rc1 must still be accepted; v1alpha1 upgrade must stay detached (nohup/background) because keadm restarts edgecore, and output must still go to /tmp/keadm.log. An over-broad fix that rejects ':' or '@', requires a non-empty Image, or waits synchronously on keadm breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: Version string with shell metacharacters (; $( ) ` newline)
Image string with shell metacharacters, optional (empty allowed)
Image with registry:port, tag, or @sha256 digest (must pass)
v1alpha1 UpgradeID / HistoryID / ConfigFile fields (argv-only, fix.diff:932-942)

O7_producer.where: edge/pkg/metamanager/dao/dbclient/upgrade_v2.go:79-120 (spec saved in preRun at edge/pkg/taskmanager/actions/nodeupgradejob.go:92-93, reloaded by edge/pkg/metamanager/metaserver/handlerfactory/extend_confirm_upgrade.go:43-44 and replayed from BackUp at :99-100, skipping checkItems)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ConfigUpdateJob (v1alpha2 operations CRD) UpdateFields map keys and values are joined into 'keadm config-update --set k=v,...' and run via bash -c on the edge; untouched by the fix.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different CRD and feature (config update, not upgrade); advisory names only NodeUpgradeJob.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package (edge/pkg/taskmanager/actions), sibling file of the landing point; no cloud webhook for it (no UpdateFields check outside this file)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: v1alpha1 rollback already builds a bash -c nohup command with UpgradeID; a variant that also passes a spec field (e.g. history/version) would be a legacy-path sibling
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: keadm rollback edge takes --history; a maintainer wiring HistoryID from the request instead of version.Get() is a one-line change in the same style as node_upgrade.go:194

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a normaliser that composes or rewrites Image/Version (e.g. adds the 'v' prefix or splits a tag off Image) after validation, so the checked value differs from the executed one
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: v1alpha1 controller already rewrites Image to repo:Version (cloud/pkg/taskmanager/v1alpha1/nodeupgradecontroller/node_upgrade_controller.go:278-290); a parallel v1alpha2 mapper is plausible

O8b_injection_room.sibling: keadm upgrade itself using ToVersion/Image in a shell copy/backup step
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: keadm util code shells out widely via execs.NewCommand with fmt.Sprintf (keadm/cmd/keadm/app/cmd/util/common_others.go:161-195)

O9_family: OS command injection (CWE-78): untrusted CR fields interpolated into bash -c command line

O10_build.project_tests: edge/pkg/taskmanager/actions/nodeupgradejob_test.go (gomonkey, needs -gcflags=all=-l), cloud/pkg/admissioncontroller/admit_nodeupgradejob_test.go, pkg/util/validation/validation_test.go, edge/pkg/metamanager/metaserver/handlerfactory/extend_confirm_upgrade_test.go; v1alpha1 taskexecutor has no tests at pin

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Validate or quote Version/Image only in checkItems (or only in the v1alpha2 upgrade action), leaving the confirm-reload path, the v1alpha1 bash -c executor and ConfigUpdateJob's shell open.

out_of_scope_notes: keadm installer utilities shell out with fmt.Sprintf-built strings (keadm/cmd/keadm/app/cmd/util/common_others.go:161-195), but these take local CLI/operator input, not cloud CRs.
keadm upgrade uses ToVersion in a filesystem path (keadm/cmd/keadm/app/cmd/edge/upgrade.go:183); path handling is a different weakness.
unverified: Whether ConfigUpdateJob UpdateFields is constrained elsewhere (CRD OpenAPI pattern) was not checked beyond build/crds/operations/operations_v1alpha2_configupdatejob.yaml:124 description; and whether graders accept it as the same protection (same sink and API group, different CRD).

v1alpha1 UpgradeID comes from the object name (cloud/pkg/taskmanager/v1alpha1/nodeupgradecontroller/node_upgrade_controller.go:305), so it is probably constrained by API-server name validation; not confirmed.
